General-content county map also showing rural buildings and householders' names; the larger insets show buildings, lot lines, and some occupants' names. Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored to emphasize town (township) boundaries. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1857 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the ... Eastern District of Pennsylvania." Mounted on cloth backing in northern/southern segments (sheets). LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, trimmed at outer edges, fold-lined, darkened at fold lines, sheets thirded to enable folding. Includes population statistical table, local business directories, small-town insets (Addison, Bath, Corning, Hornellsville), 31 village insets, and illustrations of prominent residences.
